extraction.Name: Alvina Turgeon Ducharme
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Yes on two occasions, first for $2500 and again for $2000.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Yes, but I do not know the amount.
extraction.Occupation/Income: By milking cows and what we raise on the farm.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at Herrick, South Dakota; Narcisse McKenzie the interpreter gave it to her; signed a receipt for it; has no biological children but has adopted one; health has been poor for some time — that is the reason she borrowed money on the land; mortgages are not paid; did not ask for this patent; land is still owned by her; notarized April 30, 1929 by Jas. W. Gross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
